id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

featureIdToPrecomputedFeature.description: A map of feature id to feature data. Stores the precomputed features with the {@link #precomputedFields} filled in.

precomputedFields.description:
The set of fields on the features that have been precomputed. This is equivalent to the
fields present on every value of {@link #featureIdToPrecomputedFeature}.

Used to determine if more fields need to be fetched,
or if the {@link #featureIdToPrecomputedFeature} is sufficient.

alert.description: The {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} that this {@link PrecomputedFeatures} is storing features for.

title:
Stores precomputed features for an entity mixing {@link WithPrecomputedFeatures}. The {@link PrecomputedFeatures}
instance has the same {@link #id} as the {@link WithPrecomputedFeatures} instance it is storing features for.

Currently, no pruning is done to make sure the size of this table does not grow indefinitely. If feature fetching
queries slow down, use {@link #clearPrecomputedFeatures} to remove old precomputed features.

This type is a derived data store.
**Do not store any data here that you are unwilling to recompute as it could be removed**
name: PrecomputedFeatures
